answer: Each new key locks a deposit and receives a private, jittered duty window on the shared garden roster. To earn that epoch, it must check in during that window and reveal a hash of the nonce it sealed in onyx at signup, plus a fresh salt. Windows last only a few minutes and are staggered on purpose, so one operator cannot walk a vine of sockpuppet keys through the same slot. A farm of N identities therefore needs N attendants, or it misses windows and the deposit burns; reused nonces or lockstep timings are slashed.
